blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning has produced powerful visual representations, yet learning strong dense features remains challenging. While consistency between augmented views provides strong image-level supervision, extending this principle to local visual content is less straightforward. Existing approaches often match individual patches across views or identify coherent regions, introducing uncertainties in correspondence estimation and assumptions about how visual content should be grouped. We introduce ReCoCo (Regional Composition Consistency), a principled approach that extends cross-view consistency to the regional level without requiring such correspondences or semantic grouping. ReCoCo represents the content shared between augmented views through compositions of their patch-level predictions over learned visual prototypes. By aligning these compositions, the model learns from regions containing multiple visual concepts without requiring them to be separated beforehand. ReCoCo integrates naturally with teacher-student self-distillation and introduces no additional learned parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in frozen-feature segmentation, clustering, and regional retrieval while maintaining competitive image-level recognition, alleviating the trade-off between dense and global representation quality.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习产生了强大的视觉表现,然而学习强烈的密集特征仍然具有挑战性. 虽然增强观点之间的一致性提供了强有力的图像层面的监督,但将这一原则推广到当地视觉内容并不那么直接。 现有方法往往与各种观点相匹配,或确定一致的区域,从而在函证估计和关于视觉内容应如何分组的假设方面产生不确定性。 我们采用了ReCoCo(区域构成一致性),这是一种原则性做法,将交叉观点的连贯性扩大到区域一级,而不需要这种对应或语义分类。 ReCoCo代表了通过补丁水平预测对所学视觉原型的构成而增加的视图之间共享的内容. 通过调整这些组成,模型从包含多种视觉概念的区域学习,而不需要事先将它们分开. ReCoCo自然与师生自我消化融合,不引入额外的学习参数. 广泛的实验表明,在保持具有竞争力的图像水平识别的同时,在冷冻地貌分化、集聚和区域检索方面有重大改进,减轻了稠密与全球代表性质量之间的权衡。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Self-supervised learning (SSL) has established cross-view consistency as a powerful principle for learning transferable visual representations [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
By encouraging different augmented views of an image to produce compatible representations, models learn to capture visual information that persists across changes in appearance, scale, and spatial coverage. However, when augmented views share only part of an image, it becomes less clear what their representations should agree on. At the image level, agreement can be enforced between global representations. At the patch level, it typically requires identifying which visual elements correspond. Neither formulation directly expresses agreement on the heterogeneous content shared between two views.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的学习(SSL)确立了交叉视角一致性,是学习可转移视觉表现[2,3,4,5,6]的有力原则.
通过鼓励对图像的不同增强观点以产生相容的表示,模型学会捕捉在外观、尺度和空间覆盖变化中持续存在的视觉信息。 然而,如果增加的意见只分享一部分形象,那么他们的意见应商定什么就不那么明确了。 在形象方面,全球代表之间可以达成协议。 在补丁层面,通常需要识别哪些视觉元素对应. 这两种措词都直接表达了对两种观点之间共有的不同内容的一致意见。

blocks.en: This limitation becomes more apparent in dense representation learning. Methods such as DINO [ 5 ] enforce agreement between global representations of augmented views, but do not explicitly capture how objects, parts, and background contribute to them. iBOT [ 6 ] introduces finer supervision through masked-patch prediction, although its patch-level objective operates within the same crop rather than across different views. Neither objective directly enforces consistency over the local content shared between views, leaving a gap between global agreement and individual-patch supervision.
blocks.zh: 这种局限性在密集的代表性学习中变得更加明显。 DINO[5] 等方法强制在全球代表扩大观点之间达成协议,但没有明确说明对象、部分和背景如何促进这些观点。 iBOT [6] 通过遮掩-patch预测引入了更细密的监管,尽管其补丁级目标运行在同一个作物内,而不是跨越不同观点. 这两项目标都直接加强观点之间分享的当地内容的一致性,从而造成全球协议与个人监督之间的差距。

blocks.en: Extending cross-view consistency to local content is challenging because augmentation changes not only appearance but also the spatial support of visual tokens. Existing approaches commonly address this by establishing patch correspondences through feature similarity [ 7 , 8 ] or augmentation geometry [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . The former relies on potentially unreliable learned features, while the latter matches spatial locations that may capture different visual content due to differences in crop scale and patch resolution. Both approaches therefore depend on potentially imperfect one-to-one correspondences.
blocks.zh: 将跨视图一致性扩展到本地内容具有挑战性,因为增强不仅会改变外观,而且会改变视觉符号的空间支持. 现有办法通常通过特征相近性[7、8]或增强几何[9、10、11]建立补丁通信来解决这一问题。 前者依赖潜在的不可靠的所学地物,而后者则匹配空间位置,由于作物尺度和补丁分辨率的不同而可能捕捉到不同的可视内容. 因此,这两种方法都取决于可能不完善的一对一通信。

blocks.en: To overcome the limitations of individual patch matching, existing methods explore supervision over larger groups of visual content. However, a region may contain multiple objects, parts, and background, whose distinct information can be obscured when their features are averaged into a single representation. To address this, geometry-based methods align smaller corresponding regions within overlapping views to preserve local information [ 12 , 13 ] , while others identify object-like groups through segmentation, clustering, or learned feature similarity [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . Although these approaches provide more focused supervision, they require either selecting smaller regions or identifying meaningful groups, introducing additional assumptions about which visual content should be aligned.
blocks.zh: 为了克服单个补丁匹配的局限性,现有方法探索了对更大组视觉内容的监督. 然而,一个区域可能包含多个对象、部分和背景,如果其特征被平均为单一的表示,其独特信息就可能模糊不清。 为了解决这一问题,以几何学为基础的方法将重叠观点中较小的对应区域相配合,以保存局部信息[12,13],而其他方法则通过分块、集群或学到的特征相似性确定类似物体的群体[14,15,16,17,18]. 虽然这些办法提供了更有重点的监督,但它们要求选择较小的区域或确定有意义的群体,并引入关于哪些视觉内容应当一致的其他假设。

blocks.en: We take a different perspective in which cross-view consistency is enforced through the composition of shared visual content, rather than individual patch correspondences or pooled feature representations. By representing a region through the distribution of its patch-level prototype predictions, we can account for multiple visual concepts without explicitly separating them. The strength of this formulation lies in its simplicity. It provides a principled way to enforce consistency over shared visual content across different crop scales and patch resolutions, without requiring explicit correspondences or semantic grouping. Augmentation geometry determines which content is shared, while prototype distributions define how agreement is enforced.
blocks.zh: 我们采取不同的观点,即通过共享视觉内容的构成,而不是单个补丁通信或集合特征表述,实现交叉视图的一致性。 通过通过分配其补丁级原型预测来代表一个区域,我们可以在不明确区分的情况下来说明多个视觉概念. 这种提法的优点在于它简单. 它提供了一个原则性的方法,在不同的作物尺度和补丁分辨率上对共享的视觉内容实行一致性,而不需要明确的通信或语义分类。 增强几何决定了哪些内容是共享的,而原型分配则定义了协议是如何执行的.

blocks.en: Building on this idea, we introduce ReCoCo ( Re gional Co mposition Co nsistency), which aligns the prototype compositions of overlapping augmented views (Figure 2 ). For each pair of views, we identify their shared region and independently average the patch-level prototype predictions within it. The student is then trained to match the teacher’s composition, without requiring aligned patch grids or equal numbers of patches. This provides regional supervision alongside image-level and masked-patch objectives within the same prototype space, without extra parameters.
blocks.zh: 在这个想法的基础上,我们引入了ReCoCo(Re gional Co mposition Co sistency),它协调了重叠增强观点的原型组成(图2.). 对于每一对观点,我们确定它们共享的区域,并独立平均其中的补丁级原型预测. 然后对学生进行培训,使其与教师的构成相匹配,而不需要对齐的补丁网格或同等数量的补丁. 这提供区域监督,同时在同一个原型空间内实现图像级别和被遮住的标尺目标,没有额外的参数。

blocks.en: Empirically, ReCoCo delivers substantial improvements over existing SSL approaches in frozen-feature dense prediction while maintaining competitive image-level recognition (Figure 1 ). For example, on PASCAL VOC, it improves over the baseline by 14.6 and 10.8 mIoU points under k k -NN and linear probing, respectively, with gains extending across downstream tasks and larger backbones.
blocks.zh: 经验是,ReCoCo在保持具有竞争力的图像水平识别的同时,在冷冻-地层密集预测中比现有的SSL方法提供大量改进(图1)。 例如,在PASCAL VOC方面,在k-NN和线性探测下,比基线分别提高了14.6和10.8 mIoU点,收益扩展到下游任务和更大的骨干。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarised as follows: • We introduce ReCoCo, a regional self-supervised objective that enforces consistency through the composition of shared visual content, without requiring patch correspondences, semantic grouping, or extra parameters. • We investigate the design choices underlying effective regional supervision through systematic ablations, demonstrating the importance of prediction-space aggregation, patch selection, and view pairing. Our feature analyses further reveal stronger within-object coherence and between-class separation. • We demonstrate substantial improvements across semantic segmentation, clustering, and retrieval tasks while preserving image-level recognition, alleviating the trade-off between dense and global representation quality.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们引入了ReCoCo,这是一个区域自我监督的目标,通过共享视觉内容的构成来强化一致性,而不需要补丁通信,语义分组,或者额外的参数. ^ 我们通过系统模拟来调查有效区域监督背后的设计选择,表明预测-空间汇总、补丁选择和取景对等的重要性。 • 我们的特征分析进一步揭示了目标内部和类别之间更加一致。 我们表现了语义分割、集群和检索任务方面的重大改进,同时保持图像层面的识别,并减轻密集和全球性代表质量之间的取舍。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Image- and patch-level self-supervision. Self-supervised pretraining objectives typically operate at two spatial granularities. At the image level, contrastive [ 2 , 19 ] , non-contrastive [ 20 ] , and clustering-based [ 21 ] methods enforce agreement between the global representations of augmented views. DINO [ 5 ] casts this agreement as teacher-student self-distillation over learned prototypes and shows that it also yields spatially meaningful features with Vision Transformers. At the patch level, masked image modelling predicts the pixels [ 22 ] , latent representations [ 23 ] , or cluster assignments [ 24 ] of masked patches. iBOT [ 6 ] combines both levels, complementing DINO with masked-patch self-distillation within the same view, and DINOv2 [ 1 ] scales this combination to curated data and large models. However, strong global features do not ensure equally strong dense features, and the two levels of supervision can interfere [ 25 , 26 ] . To improve dense features, recent pretraining recipes strengthen patch-level supervision further, extending the patch-level loss to visible tokens [ 27 , 28 ] and intermediate layers [ 28 ] , or giving masked boundary tokens a geometric target [ 29 ] . Yet in these frameworks, the image-level loss compares two views only as wholes and the patch-level loss acts within a single view, so neither enforces agreement on the local content the views share. ReCoCo adds this agreement as a regional pretraining objective alongside image-level and masked-patch losses.
blocks.zh: 图像与补丁级自控. 自我监督的预训目标一般在两个空间颗粒上运行. 在图像层面,对比性[2,19],非相冲突性[20],以及基于集群的[21]方法,强制在全球代表扩大观点之间达成协议。 DINO [5] 将这一协议作为师生自我消沉而不是学习到的原型,并表明它也与"视觉变形"产生空间有意义的特征. 在补丁级别上,被遮掩的图像建模预测了被遮掩的补丁的像素 [22],潜在表示 [23],或者集群任务 [24]. iBOT [6] 结合了两个关卡,用同视范围内的遮掩-patch自沉来补充DINO,而DINOv2 [1] 将这种结合比例化为被整理的数据和大型模型. 然而,强大的全球特征并不能确保同样强烈的密集特征,两级监督可以干涉[25,26]. 为了改善密度特性,近期的预训食谱进一步加强了补丁级监督,将补丁级损失扩展到可见的指代[27,28]和中间地层[28],或者给予被遮住的边界指标[29]. 然而在这些框架中,图像级损失只比较了整体上的两种观点,而补丁级损失则在单一视图中采取行动,因此两者都无法强制就观点共享的本地内容达成协议. ReCoCo将这项协议作为区域预训目标,与图像级别和被遮住的相片损失并列.

blocks.en: Cross-view patch correspondence. To extend cross-view agreement to local content, most dense methods first establish which patches correspond. Similarity-based methods pair each local feature with its most similar feature in the other view [ 8 , 7 ] or contrast attention-selected pixels across views [ 30 ] . Such matches are only as reliable as the features being learned and can be harmful in low-data regimes [ 10 ] . Other methods instead rely on augmentation geometry, matching locations that lie close together in the original image [ 9 , 10 ] , and VICRegL [ 11 ] combines both kinds of matching. However, when crop scales differ, matched patches differ in size and may contain different content. ADCLR [ 31 ] avoids patch correspondences by appending identical small crops as query tokens to both views and distilling their outputs. However, this introduces additional tokens and relies on shared query crops rather than directly supervising the content within the overlapping views.
blocks.zh: 交叉视图补丁通信. 为了将交叉视图协议扩展到本地内容,大多数密集的方法首先确定哪些补丁对应. 基于相似性的方法将每个局部特征与另一个视图中最相似的特征相配 [8, 7] 或对比的注意所选择的像素跨视图 [30]. 此类匹配仅能与所学特征一样可靠,在低数据制度中可能有害 [10]. 而其他方法则依赖于增强几何,匹配了原图像中相接相近的位置[9,10],而VICRegL [11]结合了两种相接. 然而,当作物尺度不同时,相匹配的补丁大小不同,可能包含不同的内容. ADCLR [31] 避免了补丁通信,将相同的小庄稼作为查询符附加到视图中并分馏出其输出. 然而,这引入了额外的符号并依赖于共享查询作物,而不是直接监督重叠观点中的内容.

blocks.en: Region-level self-supervision. Region-level methods compare pooled representations of regions rather than individual patches. Pooling features over the overlap of two views, however, merges the objects, parts, and background it may contain into one representation. Geometry-based methods therefore pool smaller regions inside the overlap, random boxes in SCRL [ 12 ] and fixed-size sliding windows in ReSim [ 13 ] . Semantic grouping methods pool features within object-like regions, identified by unsupervised segmentation [ 14 ] , soft prototype assignments [ 32 ] , clustering [ 16 , 17 ] , or the attention of concept tokens [ 18 ] . Both families focus supervision on smaller or explicitly grouped regions, and neither aggregates the overlap of two views as a whole. ReCoCo averages patch predictions instead of pooling features. The resulting composition preserves the probability mass assigned to each prototype even when the overlap contains several concepts, so ReCoCo can supervise all patches fully inside the overlap of every view pair. The supervised region is thus determined by the augmentations alone, rather than by sampled boxes, sliding windows, or discovered groups. The regional target also lies in the same prototype space as iBOT’s image-level and masked-patch targets, so the three losses differ only in granularity.
blocks.zh: 地级自控. 区域一级的方法比较了各区域的集合代表,而不是个别补丁。 但是,由于两种观点的重叠,将其中可能包含的对象、部分和背景合并为一种表述。 因此,基于几何方法将较小的区域汇集在重叠处,随机框放在SCRL[12]中,固定大小的滑动窗口放在ReSim[13]中。 语义分类法集合了类似对象区域内的特征,通过无监督分化[14],软原型任务[32],集群[16,17],或概念符的注意[18]来识别. 两个家庭都把监督的重点放在较小或明确归类的区域,两者都无法将两种观点作为一个整体加以合并。 ReCoCo平均补丁预测而不是集合特性. 由此产生的组成保留了每个原型的概率质量,即使重叠包含多个概念,因此ReCoCo可以完全监督每个视图对重叠内的所有补丁. 因此,受监督的区域是由扩增本身决定的,而不是由取样箱、滑动窗口或被发现的团体决定的。 区域目标也位于与iBOT的图像平面和被遮掩的平面目标相同的原型空间,因此这三种损失仅在颗粒性上有所不同.

blocks.en: ReCoCo encourages consistent representations of the visual content shared between augmented views. Rather than matching individual patches, whose spatial supports may differ across crops, we represent the shared region through the aggregate distribution of its patch predictions. This provides a correspondence-free representation of the common content without equal patch counts or aligned positions.
blocks.zh: ReCoCo鼓励以一致的方式表达扩大观点之间共享的视觉内容。 我们不是匹配单个补丁,而是通过其补丁预测的总分布来代表共享区域,其空间支持可能因作物而异。 这为共同内容提供了没有等同的补丁计数或一致立场的无函式表述.

blocks.en: Complementary patch-level constraints. By discarding patch identity and spatial ordering, regional composition allows two views to agree on the relative prototype mass within their shared content without establishing patch-wise correspondences. However, this agreement imposes a collective rather than an individual constraint, since different sets of patch predictions can produce the same regional composition. For instance, a region containing patches confidently assigned to two different prototypes may have the same composition as one in which all patches assign equal probability to both. This ambiguity is mitigated by the complementary masked-patch loss ℒ patch \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{patch}} , which encourages confident individual predictions by aligning student patches with the teacher’s sharpened targets at masked positions. The two losses therefore encourage consistency in both the composition of shared content and the predictions of its constituent patches, without requiring the region to be semantically homogeneous. In the Appendix, we further characterise these complementary constraints from an information-theoretic perspective.
blocks.zh: 补充补丁级制约. 通过丢弃补丁身份和空间顺序,区域构成允许两种观点在其共享内容中就相对原型质量达成一致而无需建立补丁相通. 然而,这项协议规定了一种集体的而不是个人的制约,因为不同的补丁预测可以产生同样的区域组成. 例如,含有自信地分配给两个不同原型的补丁的区域,其组成可能与所有补丁都给两者分配相同概率的区域相同。 L-mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{patch}的辅助性遮盖补丁减轻了这种模糊性, 因此,这两项损失鼓励在共享内容的构成及其组成补丁的预测方面保持一致性,而不必要求这个区域完全相同。 在附录中,我们从信息理论的角度进一步说明了这些相辅相成的制约因素。

blocks.en:
In this section, we evaluate the effectiveness of ReCoCo in learning transferable dense and global visual representations.
We first describe the training setup in Sec. 4.1 and compare ReCoCo against prior SSL methods in Sec. 4.2 . We then examine the regional objective through ablations (Sec. 4.3 ) and feature visualisations (Sec. 4.4 ). The Appendix adds transferability and representation analyses.

blocks.en: Multi-class classification. Dense self-supervised objectives often improve patch features at the expense of the global representation. We test this trade-off on ImageNet-1K [ 33 ] with a weighted k k -NN classifier on the [ CLS ] [\mathrm{CLS}] token, using 1 % 1\% , 10 % 10\% or 100 % 100\% of the training set as reference bank, and with a linear probe trained on the full training set (Table 3 ). The dense methods CrOC [ 16 ] , CrIBo [ 17 ] and CG-SSL [ 18 ] all fall below iBOT [ 6 ] , whereas ReCoCo maintains its accuracy in every setting. The regional loss thus strengthens the patch features without compromising image-level recognition.

blocks.en: Multi-label classification. Multi-label recognition requires a single image representation to capture every object in a scene, not only the dominant one. We train linear probes on frozen features at 224 × 224 224\times 224 on VOC [ 35 ] , COCO [ 38 ] and Visual Genome [ 40 ] , and in low-shot regimes on VOC with one, two or five training images per class (Table 4 ). ReCoCo achieves the highest mAP in all six settings. Its advantage over iBOT is largest when training images are scarce ( + 4.3 +4.3 and + 4.0 +4.0 mAP with one and two images per class) and, with full data, on COCO ( + 1.5 +1.5 ), whose images typically contain several objects. This suggests that supervising the composition of regions also benefits the image-level features of scenes with multiple objects.

Following [ 41 ] , we mean-pool frozen backbone features within ground-truth COCO query masks and SAM [ 42 ] gallery regions, ranking images by their best-matching region (Table 5 ). ReCoCo nearly doubles iBOT’s mAP, from 20.9 20.9 to 38.4 38.4 , and raises Precision@50 from 32.1 32.1 to 48.4 48.4 . blocks.en: Feature analysis. To understand what the regional loss changes in the features, we measure the variance of the patch features inside the annotated objects of the VOC validation set (Figure 3 a). ReCoCo redistributes this variance rather than removing it. This follows from the objective: two views agree on the composition of a shared region only if patches of the same content select the same prototypes, so the patches of an object concentrate on a few prototypes and their variance falls. As the prototypes are shared across images, objects of a class select the same ones and different classes select different ones, which increases the variance between classes. Segmentation, clustering and retrieval gain from compact objects and well-separated classes. Tasks that instead read the fine variation inside an object, such as patch-to-patch correspondence and depth estimation (Figure 3 b; protocols of Probe3D [ 43 ] ), do not draw on this organisation: depth is unchanged and correspondence slightly degrades.

ReCoCo重新分配了这个差异而不是去除. 这源于目标:只有相同内容的补丁选择了相同的原型,两种观点才同意一个共享区域的构成,因此一个物体的补丁集中在几个原型上,它们的差异会下降. 由于原型在图像之间共享,一个类的对象会选择同一种,不同的类则会选择不同的,这增加了各类之间的差异. 从紧凑对象和分离良好的类别中分化、集群和取回收益。 读取对象内部的细微变化的任务,如补丁到patch函证和深度估计(图3b; Probe3D [43] 的协议),不取自这个组织:深度不变,函证会稍有降解.

blocks.en: View and patch selection. Table 6 c examines which views and patches should form the compositions. Being an average, a composition needs no one-to-one correspondence and can compare regions of different sizes and scales, an advantage over patch-wise matching. Adding global-to-local pairs (global & local) exploits this: it gives the best result on all three metrics and is the setting of our main experiments, whereas local pairs alone (local) are not sufficient. blocks.en: Shared area and patch coverage. Figure 4 a and b examine how strictly regions and patches should be selected. Admitting partially covered patches slightly lowers both segmentation scores, even when they are weighted, because they encode content absent from the other view. The best option is therefore to keep overlaps of every tested size with all the patches fully inside them and not impose any further restrictions on the shared area.

blocks.en: Prototype maps. The regional loss constrains only the composition of a shared region and never assigns a prototype to an individual patch. To show how the patch predictions change nonetheless, Figure 5 a colours each patch by its most probable prototype. iBOT’s prototypes change from one patch to the next, even inside an object. ReCoCo instead covers each object with one or two prototypes, which are shared by objects of the same class across images and differ between classes.
blocks.zh: 原型地图. 区域损失只制约了共享区域的构成,从未将原型分配给单个补丁. 为了显示补丁预测的变化情况,图5用最有可能的原型来显示每个补丁的颜色。 iBOT的原型从一个补丁变为下一个补丁,甚至在一个物体内. ReCoCo取而代之的是用一到两个原型来覆盖每个对象,这些原型由同一类对象在图像上互通共享,不同类别之间也有所不同.

blocks.en: PCA of patch features. The frozen-feature evaluations use the backbone features rather than the prototype predictions. Figure 5 b therefore maps the first three principal components of the patch features to RGB. ReCoCo’s components follow object boundaries more closely, separating objects from their background while keeping their parts distinct.
blocks.zh: 补丁特性的PCA. 被冻结的地貌评价使用主干特征而不是原型预测. 因此,图5b将补丁特性的前三个主要组成部分映射到RGB. ReCoCo的组件更紧密地跟随对象边界,将对象从背景中分离出,同时保持其部分的区别.

blocks.en: Patch similarity. Figure 5 c shows the cosine similarity between a query patch and every other patch of the image. With iBOT, high similarity stays close to the query. With ReCoCo, it extends over the whole object and reaches other instances of its class. Patches of the same class thus lie close together in feature space, the property that k k -NN segmentation, clustering and retrieval rely on.
blocks.zh: 补丁相似. 图5 c 显示了查询补丁与图像中所有其他补丁之间的余弦相似性. 与 iBOT 相比,高度相似性仍然与查询相近. 与ReCoCo一起,它延伸至整个对象并达到其类中的其他实例. 因此,同一类的补丁在特征空间、k-NN分区、集群和检索所依赖的属性相接相近。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ReCoCo, a regional self-supervised objective that extends cross-view consistency to the visual content shared between augmented views. By aligning compositions of patch predictions over learned prototypes, ReCoCo provides regional supervision without requiring patch correspondences or semantic grouping. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in frozen-feature segmentation, clustering, and retrieval while maintaining strong image-level recognition. Our analysis reveals more coherent representations within objects and greater separation between classes, with these improvements reflected in the backbone features. These findings establish regional composition agreement as a simple and effective supervisory signal bridging image-level consistency and individual-patch prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ReCoCo,这是一个区域自我监督的目标,它把交叉视图的连贯性延伸到了在扩大观点之间共享的视觉内容。 通过将补丁预测的构成与所学原型相协调,ReCoCo提供区域监督,而不需要补丁通信或语义分组. 广泛的实验表明,在保持强烈图像水平识别的同时,在冷冻地貌分解、集群和取回方面有重大改进。 我们的分析显示,目标内部的表述更加一致,类别之间更加分离,这些改进体现在骨干特征中。 这些结论将区域构成协议确立为一种简单而有效的监督信号,将图像层面的一致性和个体分布预测联系起来。

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. Regional composition encourages semantic consistency across views but does not explicitly preserve fine-grained spatial relationships. Thus, its benefits are less pronounced on geometry-sensitive tasks, with slightly degraded keypoint correspondence and largely unchanged depth estimation. Future work could explore how to improve geometric representations while retaining the benefits of correspondence-free regional supervision.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 区域构成鼓励不同观点的语义一致性,但没有明确保留精细的空间关系。 因此,它对几何敏感任务的好处并不明显,关键点对应略有退化,深度估计基本没有变化。 今后的工作可以探讨如何改进几何表述,同时保留无通信区域监督的好处。
